title: Liquid: Display Content Items, Shapes and Zones | Orchard Core
description:
A Liquid template does not receive a page. It receives a shape, and it has to read that shape, place content in the zones of the layout, and draw other content items.

This video shows how Orchard Core builds a page from shapes, and how Liquid draws a content item, fills the zones of a layout, loads and renders other content items, and creates and changes shapes. The examples come from The Blog Theme.

In this video:
• Shapes and zones: what a Liquid template receives
• The Blog page: zones on a real page
• A template for a content item: draw the shapes of a content item
• Zones and layouts: place content anywhere in the page
• Other content items: load an item and draw it
• Create and change shapes: build shapes inside a template
